summary:
ResQ Link is a smart personal safety application designed to prevent kidnappings and improve emergency response through automated threat detection and real-time location tracking. Unlike traditional safety apps that depend on manual SOS activation, ResQ Link introduces proactive and hands-free safety mechanisms.

The application features a Safe Ride mode that periodically checks on users through calls and notifications. If a user fails to respond or enters an incorrect ResQ PIN three consecutive times, the system alerts law enforcement and emergency contacts with their live location.

It also incorporates hands-free SOS functionality that detects suspicious distress movements and triggers emergency alerts if the user fails to respond within five minutes. Additionally, ResQ Link supports external GPS devices and GPS-integrated ornaments, allowing location tracking to continue even if the user's phone is lost or discarded.

Our goal is to make personal security smarter, faster, automatic, and accessible.
details:
ResQ Link is a smart personal safety platform designed to address the risks of kidnapping, unsafe travel and delayed emergency response.

The project introduces three key features:

  1. Safe Ride Mode: Users can activate a journey check-in system that periodically requests confirmation through calls or notifications. If the user fails to respond or enters an incorrect ResQ PIN three consecutive times, the proposed system initiates an emergency alert with the user's location.
  2. Hands-Free SOS: The proposed system aims to identify suspicious distress movements and request user confirmation. If the user does not respond within the configured time, an emergency alert is triggered.
  3. Independent GPS Tracking: ResQ Link proposes integration with external GPS devices or GPS-enabled accessories so that location transmission can continue even if the phone is lost or discarded.

We have developed an interactive web prototype to demonstrate the user interface, Safe Ride PIN flow, SOS interface and browser-based location access.

The prototype uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including the browser Geolocation API. Our approach focuses on proactive safety, discreet emergency assistance and accessible technology.

Our long-term goal is to reduce emergency response delays and make personal safety more intelligent, accessible and reliable.
